invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Iterator; it never returns null in any execution path.
If recordItr has next value, the result is a JavaLazyInsertIterable.
When no records are present, result is an iterator with a single empty list.
If there are records to process, the returned iterator is not empty.
idPfx is always passed to the underlying JavaLazyInsertIterable or reflected in the singleton result.
